page.layout: One column of running text, with three marginal notes in the right margin. The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: genus effuse irrueret, flagitia in tenebris admittere, abiecti & pulilli animi puta-uit; palàm autem, atque in oculis omnium, (Regale quiddã esse & solo Imperatore dignum.) Tandem Morbo Comitiali correptus; vel ut alij, multo oneratus mero, vivus sepultus est inter mortuos,qui mortuus vixit inter vivos. Vos itaque Monarchiae & mundi præsi-des, licèt humanis castigationibus non subijciamini, his tamcn exemplis.

p.i: Discite iustitiam moniti,& non temnere Divos.

main_text.p: Sed ad penfum me reuoco, imperante Anastasio,regnauit in Africa Thrasimun-dus gente Gothus, naturâ barbarus, hæ-resi Arrianus. Hic in initio regni sui Orthodoxos persequutus est; non poenis corporis, aut supplicijs, ut alij (inquit{e}De bello Vand. li. 1. Procopius) sed præmijs ac honoribus, ad deferendam fidem invitauit; {f}Paulo Di-alona de ge-stis Rom.lib. 15.Posteà vero temporis progressu, cùm se parùm aut nihil lucratum istiusmodi tendiculis vidisset, adeò acriter in illos defævijt, ut simul 220, Episcopos Catholicos, & inter illos Fulgentium E-piscopum Ruspensem, in insulam Sardini-am.

page.notes: Possible printing error: "tamcn" in line 6 of the first paragraph, probably for "tamen". The italic note text on the right is set in a smaller size and is taken as a note, not as main text. The Virgil quotation "Discite iustitiam moniti" is set in italics on its own line. The spelling "præsi-des" is read as printed but is not fully certain.
